effect.scope: This slip only. Does not establish a general rule for cross-month settlements.

decisions.preserved_regardless: The four evidenced service dates (26/07, 28/07, 31/07, 03/08) and their subtotals remain recorded in extraction_part6.json. The exception changes which month the cost is booked to; it does not erase the observed delivery dates.

If those July deliveries are already in the July rows, booking this slip to August duplicates them.
An owner-approved exception cannot turn a duplicate into a non-duplicate (OCR_RULES, Stop Conditions).

decisions.question: ฿8,100 paid but the three memo lines total ฿7,600 — ฿500 unexplained.
decisions.owner_answer: maybe i transfer more 500 thb for coconut
decisions.owner_hypothesis: An overpayment of ฿500 to the coconut supplier.
why_still_open: The answer is qualified ('maybe'), so it is recorded as a hypothesis, not an observation. OCR_RULES 7 requires critical monetary discrepancies to be resolved or covered by an owner-approved exception that clearly limits downstream claims.

The accounting treatment differs by explanation and changes the COGS figure: (a) an overpayment leaves ฿7,600 as coconut COGS and ฿500 as a supplier advance/receivable; (b) a higher freight or an unwritten extra item makes the whole ฿8,100 COGS. These are not equivalent.
Certain: ฿8,100.00 was paid. Certain: the written lines account for ฿7,600.00.
questions_for_owner: Confirm whether the ฿500 was an overpayment to be credited against a later delivery, or payment for something not written in the memo.
If it was an overpayment, was it offset against a later coconut purchase in August or September?
